messages:
aj_support: Escalating: NutraSense trial blocked. Embeddings and ingestion calls returning 403 for the trial org. Trial demo in 48h, customer asks for a demo flow. Marking P1 to CS. :rotating_light:

maria_cs: Thanks AJ. Paste error + request id and confirm hosted vs dedicated. We need owners for comms + workaround.

aj_support: Hosted. Error: "403 Forbidden - invalid key". Request ID: rq_90f1b2. Reproduced after rotating test key. Repro steps attached.

kevin_engineering: I'll triage auth service. Suspect key propagation or cache invalidation. ETA 90m. Tagging devon_oncall for infra alerts.

devon_oncall: Noted. Spinning up incident: INC-2026-0502-09. I'll pull auth logs and notify pager.

maria_cs: Immediate comms plan: 0h ack + UI workaround (create UI token + manual upload) + ETA; 6h technical update; 24h resolution or offer 14-day extension + live onboarding. Nora, check renewal sensitivity and prepare AE copy.

nora_aesales: Got it. This account is strategic SMB for April quota. If friction persists, escalate to AE leadership. Draft customer paragraph requested.

aj_support: Workaround sent to customer: use UI token path; they can continue testing via UI. They confirmed it works for now.

kevin_engineering: Quick update: found a race in auth cache refresh when keys rotate rapidly. Pushed a fix to canary and increased cache TTL. Monitoring 30m.

maria_cs: Maria: If canary stable for 30m, we'll tell customer fix deployed and ask them to retry. If flakey, proceed with extension offer. Nora, here is a short note to send: "Hi NutraSense team — we found an auth edge case affecting rotated test keys. Engineering deployed a fix to production and wed ask you to retry the demo. If you still see issues we will extend your trial by 14 days and book a dedicated onboarding session. Apologies for the interruption. — Maria"

nora_aesales: Sending now. Copying legal for extension approval.

sre-bot: Incident INC-2026-0502-09 status: mitigated.

kevin_engineering: Canary looks good, promoting to prod in 10m. Continuing to monitor.

aj_support: Customer retried and confirmed API calls succeed after the fix. They appreciated the quick response. Closing the escalation. :thumbsup:
